prd: /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Automatos-AI-Platform/automatos-investor/portal/PRD-001-investor-portal.md (private repo, READ ONLY: never copy its private sections into this public repo)
description: Wave 1 (the core) of the investor portal at automatos.app/investors: a React app served by the site's Express server, Clerk sign-in, a short investor profile, a document library with a PDF viewer and downloads, per-page reading events, an admin area (document upload, overview, investors table and detail) and admin alert emails. Data lives in Postgres schema 'investors' (its own role); files in a private S3 bucket. Wave 2 (sections, video, document analytics, CSV, privacy text, footer link) is a later kit.

decisions.text: FILES. A story may create or change ONLY: investors/** (the React app), server/investors/** (the API, its SQL migrations and its tests), vitest.config.js (root), server.js (ADDITIVE ONLY: the portal import, its mount lines and the Clerk key in hydrateConfig; the public allow-list arrays CLEAN_URL_PAGES, HTML_ONLY_PAGES and PUBLIC_ASSETS stay byte-identical), _config.js.template (one added line), Dockerfile, .dockerignore, package.json, package-lock.json (root), .github/workflows/investors.yml (new), README.md (a 'Investor portal' section), and this kit's files under scripts/ralph/. Never: any existing .html page, any _*.js or *.css of the public site, images/, uploads/, content/, design/, .github/workflows/malware-scan.yml, .gitignore entries that un-ignore anything.

DEPENDENCIES: only these, each installed with 'npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts <name>@<major>' (or the exact version given) and recorded in the DONE note. ROOT dependencies: the existing compression, express, nodemailer, plus @clerk/backend@3, pg@8, @aws-sdk/client-s3@3, @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner@3, zod@3, express-rate-limit@7. ROOT devDependencies: vitest@3, supertest@7, @electric-sql/pglite@0.5. investors/ dependencies: react@18, react-dom@18, react-router-dom@6, @tanstack/react-query@5, @clerk/clerk-react@5, react-pdf@9, pdfjs-dist (exactly the version react-pdf@9 depends on, 4.8.69), recharts@2, lucide-react@0, class-variance-authority@0.7, clsx@2, tailwind-merge@2 (NOT 3: v3 is Tailwind 4 only), tailwindcss-animate@1, sonner@2, zod@3, any @radix-ui/react-* package. investors/ devDependencies: vite@6, @vitejs/plugin-react@4, typescript@5, tailwindcss@3, postcss@8, autoprefixer@10, eslint@9, @eslint/js@9, typescript-eslint@8, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5, eslint-plugin-react-refresh@0, globals, vitest@3, jsdom@26, @testing-library/react@16, @testing-library/jest-dom@6, @types/react@18, @types/react-dom@18, @types/node@22, @playwright/test@1.64.1 (exact). Anything else: RALPH_BLOCKED with the reason. The gate enforces the list and the majors.

SERVER-SIDE ENFORCEMENT. Every /api/investors route except GET /api/investors/health goes through the auth middleware; identity (clerk user id, email, investor id) comes ONLY from the verified Clerk token, never from a body, query, header other than Authorization, or cookie; admin = the token's Clerk user id is in INVESTOR_ADMIN_CLERK_IDS (comma-separated), checked on the server for every /admin route. A blocked investor gets 403 on every investor route. Unpublished documents are 404 to investors. A test enumerates the router stack and fails if any route other than /health lacks the middleware.

NEVER BREAK THE SITE. The portal is optional. Missing config (INVESTORS_DATABASE_URL, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, or the S3 variables for document routes) or a failed migration puts the portal in 'disabled' with a logged reason: /api/investors/* answers 503 {error:'portal_unavailable'} and /investors serves the app, which shows 'The investor portal is temporarily unavailable' and the contact link. Every other route of automatos.app behaves exactly as on the base. Startup never throws because of the portal; migrations run in the background after app.listen and the portal answers 503 'starting' until they finish.

PUBLIC REPO. This repository is public. Never commit: env files (the secrets hook blocks *.env and *.env.* paths: document variable NAMES in README.md instead, never an .env.example), keys or tokens (sk_live_, sk_test_ with a real value, pk_live_, AKIA..., private keys), real documents, real investor names or emails, the names of the site's admins, or text from the private PRD's content plan or open questions. Test fixtures are invented (investor 'Ada Example' at 'Example Ventures', ada@example.com) and tiny (a generated one- or two-page PDF under 20 kB). No vendor branding from the reference portal (KP12).

LOCAL CHECKS ARE PURE NODE. Allowed on this machine: npm ci/install (KP2 rules), tsc, eslint, vitest (jsdom and PGlite run in-process), vite build, node --check, reading node_modules. NEVER on this machine: node server.js, vite dev, vite preview, any server or listening socket, Playwright, a browser, docker, gh workflow run, git push, opening a PR, git merge. Playwright and the docker build run in CI only (W1-05, W1-19).

TEST DATABASE. Server code talks to Postgres only through server/investors/db.js: createDb({connectionString}) over pg.Pool (max 5, idleTimeoutMillis 30000) exposing query(text, params) and tx(fn). Tests use the same interface over PGlite (@electric-sql/pglite, real Postgres in-process) via server/investors/__tests__/helpers/test-db.js, or over pg when INVESTORS_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (CI's Postgres service). Every SQL statement is parameterized ($1..$n) and schema-qualified (investors.<table>); no string-built SQL with request data.

MIGRATIONS (deviation from the PRD's node-pg-migrate, so tests run on PGlite): numbered plain SQL files server/investors/migrations/NNN_name.sql, applied in order by server/investors/migrate.js. The runner: creates schema 'investors' only when pg_namespace lacks it (in production the schema already exists, owned by the portal's role), creates investors.schema_migrations(name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now()), then applies each missing file in its own transaction after SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724001) and records it. Re-running is a no-op. A failed file rolls back and disables the portal (KP4).

CLERK. App: @clerk/clerk-react@5 <ClerkProvider publishableKey={window.AUTOMATOS_CONFIG.clerkPublishableKey}> (runtime config, hydrated by server.js from CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; never a build-time env). API calls send 'Authorization: Bearer <await getToken()>'. Server: @clerk/backend verifyToken(token, {secretKey, authorizedParties}) with authorizedParties from INVESTORS_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES (comma-separated, default 'https://automatos.app'), behind an injectable verifier (academy server/spine/auth.js pattern) so tests use a fake. Investor email and name come from the Clerk user (createClerkClient({secretKey}).users.getUser, cached per process for 10 minutes) on first sight; later requests read the row. NO cookie auth anywhere (stricter than the PRD): the pagehide flush uses fetch(..., {keepalive: true}) with the last cached token.

E2E FAKE AUTH SEAM. investors/src/auth/ has ONE module that wraps Clerk (useAuthState, SignedInGate, AccountMenu, getToken). When import.meta.env.VITE_INVESTORS_E2E === '1' (set ONLY by the e2e build script) it swaps to a fake provider whose code contains the marker string 'INVESTORS_E2E_FAKE_AUTH'. The production build (npm run build) must not contain that marker (vite dead-code-eliminates the branch; the gate greps investors/dist). The server has no fake verifier outside tests.

S3. server/investors/s3.js (pattern: academy server/media/s3.js, lazy S3Client) with an injectable client; env INVESTOR_DOCS_BUCKET, INVESTOR_DOCS_REGION, INVESTOR_DOCS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, INVESTOR_DOCS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Keys: documents/<documentId>/v<version>/<safeFileName> (safeFileName: [A-Za-z0-9._-] only, max 120 chars). Presigned PUT 15 minutes with ContentType fixed; presigned GET 5 minutes with ResponseContentDisposition (inline or attachment; filename*=UTF-8 encoded). Allowed content types: application/pdf, video/mp4, text/csv, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document. Max 262144000 bytes (250 MB). Never log a presigned URL.

REFERENCE PORTAL (READ ONLY, never edit): /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Dr-Green-Cannexis/Dr-Green-Gateway. Port its UI: src/components/ui/* (only the components a story uses), components.json, src/pages/Dashboard.tsx + src/components/investor/InvestorSidebar.tsx + InvestorHero.tsx (shell), src/components/investor/sections/DataRoom.tsx (library), src/components/marketplace/CoaPdfViewer.tsx (viewer), src/components/admin/AnalyticsManager.tsx (overview, table, timeline), src/components/admin/DocumentManager.tsx (upload UI), src/lib/activityTracker.ts (heartbeat idea), src/lib/csvExport.ts. Strip ALL of: its brand names, copy, colours, fonts, domains, tiers, wallet/NFT, NDA, CRM, Supabase client and calls, Lovable code. Its data-access and permission code is never ported: every data call goes to this kit's API.

LOOK. The app looks like automatos.app: fonts Geist (sans), Instrument Serif (headings), Geist Mono (labels) from the same Google Fonts URL the site uses; colours as CSS variables mapped from the site's two moods: bone (--bg #F2EDE4, --bg-2 #ECE6DA, --fg #0F1411, --fg-2 #2C3531, --muted #6E6960, --rule-c rgba(15,20,17,0.14), --accent oklch(0.45 0.06 155), --accent-ink #F2EDE4) and pitch (--bg #0E1311, --bg-2 #161C19, --fg #EFE9DD, --fg-2 #C9C2B4, --muted #8A857C, --rule-c rgba(239,233,221,0.14), --accent oklch(0.78 0.10 95), --accent-ink #0E1311). The mood follows the site: localStorage 'automatos-mood' ('bone'|'pitch'), else prefers-color-scheme; set as data-mood on <body>; Tailwind darkMode ['class'] is NOT used: shadcn tokens read the CSS variables. Square-ish corners (radius 2px), thin rules, no gradients, no glow. Phone first: every investor page works at 390 px.

COPY. Calm and factual; no 'exclusive', no hype. Tracking notice (teaser and profile form): 'When you sign in, we record which documents you open or download and how long you spend on each page, so the team can follow up with the right information. See our Privacy Policy (/privacy). Ask privacy@automatos.app to see or delete your data.' All UI strings in investors/src/strings.ts.

CODE RULES. Immutability (new objects, never mutate inputs). Files 200-400 lines, never over 800; functions under 50 lines; React components under 150 lines; nesting under 4. zod at every API boundary (server bodies and queries; client parses responses). Errors: the server returns {error:'<code>'} with the right status, logs detail server-side, never leaks stack traces; the client shows a plain message. No console.log in committed code (console.warn/error with context in the server only). Server code is plain ESM JavaScript like server.js, with JSDoc types; the app is TypeScript strict.

EVENTS. Types: signed_in, profile_completed, document_open, document_download, page_view, section_view, video_progress. document_open and document_download are written by the SERVER when it issues a link; the client may send only page_view, section_view, video_progress and heartbeats. duration_ms capped at 600000; page between 1 and the document's page_count (when known) else 1..2000; at most 50 events per batch; body at most 64 kB; 120 requests/minute/investor on /events, 30/minute on /link, 10/minute on PUT /me (express-rate-limit keyed by investor id).

WAVE 1 SCOPE. Build only W1 stories. NOT in this wave (a later kit): team/FAQ/contact sections and their editor, the video player, per-document analytics and page drop-off charts, CSV export, the privacy-policy section, the footer link, the sitemap entry, investor update emails. The admin investor table and detail ARE in this wave. Leave hooks for wave 2 only where a story says so.

ONE PUSH, ONE PR, ONE CI RUN. Story commits end ' [skip ci]' and are never pushed by you (the runner pushes the branch as a backup). No story waits on CI and no AC says 'CI green'. When every W1 story passes, the last session runs the gate (--no-ci), then makes ONE empty signed commit without [skip ci]; the runner opens the wave's draft PR and that PR's run is the wave's CI. UI stories are verified by typecheck, lint, unit tests and, at the end, the Playwright screenshots of W1-19 in CI (no local browser: KP6).

localChecks: npm test (root: vitest run over server/investors/**/__tests__)
references: The private PRD (path above): sections 4 to 12 are the spec this kit implements; section 6 is the data model, section 7 the API.

Academy (READ ONLY, via git -C /Users/gkavanagh/Development/Automatos-AI-Platform/automatos-academy show origin/main:<path>): server/spine/auth.js (Clerk verifier, authorized parties, injectable middleware), server/media/s3.js (lazy S3 client, presigned PUT), server/media/index.js and server/content/index.js (admin allowlist parse, fail-closed config).

This repo: server.js (hydrateConfig, the allow-list static middleware, the contact form's nodemailer transport), _config.js.template, Dockerfile, .dockerignore, index.html (the tokens and fonts KP13 lists), _theme.js (the mood switch).

acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/db.js: createDb({connectionString}) over pg.Pool (max 5, idleTimeoutMillis 30000) exposing query(text, params) and tx(fn) (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK on one client) and end(); pg@8 added (KP2)

server/investors/__tests__/helpers/test-db.js: createTestDb() returns the same interface over PGlite (@electric-sql/pglite@0.5, devDependency) or over pg when INVESTORS_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set; each test file gets a fresh database (PGlite) or a fresh schema reset (pg)

server/investors/migrations/001_init.sql creates, schema-qualified, exactly the PRD section 6 tables: investors (with the CHECK lists for investor_type, cheque_size, source; clerk_user_id UNIQUE; marketing_opt_in default false; blocked default false; created_at/last_seen_at default now()), documents (kind CHECK; version default 1; published default false; alert_on_first_open default false), sections (slug PK), sessions, events (type CHECK with the seven KP16 types; duration_ms CHECK between 0 and 600000; document_id ON DELETE SET NULL), alerts_sent (UNIQUE (investor_id, kind, document_id) using a unique index that treats NULL document_id as equal, e.g. COALESCE to a zero uuid), every investor FK ON DELETE CASCADE, and the three events indexes

createInvestorsPortal.start(): when config is complete, creates the db, runs migrations, sets state 'ready'; on any migration error logs it (console.error with the file name) and sets 'disabled' with reason 'migration_failed: <file>' (KP4)

server/investors/__tests__/migrate.test.js: fresh DB applies 001; second run applies nothing; deleting an investor cascades to sessions, events and alerts_sent; a CHECK violation (bad investor_type) is rejected; a broken migration file in a temp dir rolls back and leaves schema_migrations without it

userStories.title: Server-side Clerk auth, investor upsert, admin allowlist and the route-coverage test
userStories.description: As the team, every portal request is verified on the server so nobody sees investor data or documents without signing in (KP3, KP9).
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/auth.js: createClerkVerifier({secretKey, authorizedParties}) wrapping @clerk/backend@3 verifyToken (read node_modules/@clerk/backend/dist/*.d.ts for the exact signature); createUserLookup({secretKey}) wrapping users.getUser with a 10-minute in-process cache; requireInvestor({verifier, userLookup, db}) middleware: Bearer token only (no cookie), 401 {error:'unauthenticated'} when absent or invalid, upserts investors by clerk_user_id (email and name from the lookup on insert), 403 {error:'blocked'} when blocked, sets req.investor (frozen) and req.isAdmin; updates last_seen_at at most once a minute per investor; requireAdmin: 403 {error:'forbidden'} unless req.isAdmin
createInvestorsPortal wires the real verifier from config and accepts deps.verifier / deps.userLookup overrides for tests only
On an investor's first ever sign-in a signed_in event is written; later sign-ins write signed_in at most once per 30 minutes

server/investors/__tests__/auth.test.js (fake verifier + PGlite): no header 401; malformed and rejected token 401; a cookie named __session with a valid fake token is IGNORED (401); valid token upserts once (two requests, one row); blocked 403; non-admin on a probe /admin route 403; admin 200; identity ignores a body investor_id

server/investors/__tests__/route-coverage.test.js walks apiRouter's stack and fails if any route other than GET /health is reachable without requireInvestor (and every /admin path without requireAdmin); it passes now and will guard every later story

userStories.title: S3 module: presigned PUT and GET, head and delete
userStories.description: As the portal, I need private storage for documents reached only through short-lived links (KP11).
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/s3.js: createDocStore({config, client?}) with presignPut({key, contentType, contentLength}), presignGet({key, fileName, disposition:'inline'|'attachment'}), head(key) → {size, contentType}|null, remove(key); safeFileName(name) and documentKey(id, version, fileName) exported as pure helpers; content type and size checked against KP11 before presigning (throws a typed error the routes map to 400)
@aws-sdk/client-s3@3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner@3 added (KP2); the client is created lazily (academy server/media/s3.js pattern)

Tests: real presigning with fake credentials (offline): PUT URL carries the content type and 900 s expiry, GET URL carries 300 s and the disposition with an RFC 5987 filename; head/remove through an injected fake client; safeFileName strips paths and odd characters and caps 120; disallowed type and oversize rejected
npm test passes

userStories.title: Admin documents API: create, list, edit, upload, finalize, preview, delete
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to publish or replace a document without a deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/routes/admin-documents.js under requireAdmin: GET /admin/documents (all, sort_order then created_at); POST /admin/documents {title 1-160, description 0-600, category 1-60, kind, alertOnFirstOpen} → 201; PATCH /admin/documents/:id (title, description, category, kind, sortOrder, published, alertOnFirstOpen); DELETE /admin/documents/:id (removes the S3 object of the current version, then the row; events keep document_id NULL per the FK); POST /admin/documents/:id/upload-url {fileName, contentType, contentLength, pageCount?} → {url, key, expiresIn}; POST /admin/documents/:id/finalize {key, pageCount?} → HEADs the object, rejects a type or size mismatch, sets s3_key, file_name, content_type, size_bytes, page_count, bumps version when replacing; POST /admin/documents/:id/preview-link → presigned GET (inline), writes NO event
Publishing a document without an uploaded file returns 409 {error:'no_file'}
All routes 503 'storage_unavailable' when the S3 config is null (other portal routes keep working)
Responses never include s3_key except upload-url's key echo

Tests (PGlite + fake doc store): admin happy path create → upload-url → finalize → publish; replace bumps version; non-admin 403 on each route; bad id 404; zod 400s; storage null 503; delete removes the object
npm test passes (route-coverage test included)

userStories.title: Admin document manager UI

userStories.title: Investor documents API: list and open/download links with server-written events
userStories.description: As an investor, I want to open or download any published document; as the team, we want each open and download recorded by the server (KP16).
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/routes/documents.js under requireInvestor: GET /documents → published documents with a file, ordered, fields id, title, description, category, kind, fileName, contentType, sizeBytes, pageCount, version, updatedAt (no s3_key); POST /documents/:id/link {mode:'inline'|'download'} → {url, expiresIn:300} and writes document_open or document_download (with document_version) in the same request; unpublished, missing or file-less → 404; rate limit 30/min per investor

After writing a document_open for a document with alert_on_first_open, calls the alerts hook with (investor, document) when this is the investor's first open of that document (the hook stays a no-op until W1-18)
Tests (PGlite + fake store): list hides unpublished and file-less; link writes the right event type and version; 404 cases; first-open hook called once across two opens; 429 on the 31st call
npm test passes

userStories.title: PDF viewer
userStories.description: As an investor, I want to read the deck in the browser page by page on any device, and download it from the viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: investors/src/viewer/PdfViewer.tsx (ported from the reference CoaPdfViewer, KP12) with react-pdf@9; the pdf.js worker bundled locally via 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url' (no CDN); isEvalSupported false
Page navigation (previous/next, keyboard arrows), 'Page N of M', fit-to-width (ResizeObserver) so a page fits 390 px, a Download button in the toolbar (link mode download), a Back link
The link is requested on open (mode inline); if loading fails with an expired URL (HTTP 403 from storage) it requests a new link once, then shows an error with a Download fallback
The viewer exposes onPageVisible(page, ms) for W1-14 (a visibility model: a page counts when at least 50% visible for at least 1000 ms; the model is pure and unit-tested)
npm --prefix investors run typecheck, lint, test, build pass

userStories.title: Events API, sessions and the client tracker
userStories.description: As the team, we want to know which pages of which documents each investor read and for how long (KP16).
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/routes/events.js under requireInvestor: POST /sessions → {sessionId} (row with user_agent truncated to 300, no IP); POST /events {sessionId?, heartbeat?:true, events:[...]} with zod: only page_view {documentId, documentVersion?, page, durationMs}, section_view {section, durationMs}, video_progress {documentId, percent in 25|50|75|100}; at most 50; durationMs capped at 600000 (clamped, not rejected); page checked against the document's page_count when known else 1..2000; unknown documentId dropped; a sessionId not owned by the investor is ignored; heartbeat updates the session's last_heartbeat_at; express.json limit 64 kB on this router; rate limit 120/min per investor; responds 204

investors/src/tracking/tracker.ts (adapted from the reference activityTracker, KP12): starts a session after sign-in, heartbeats every 30 s while document.visibilityState is 'visible', queues events, flushes every 10 s and on pagehide with fetch(url, {method:'POST', keepalive:true, headers: Authorization with the last cached token}) (KP9: no sendBeacon, no cookie); the viewer's onPageVisible feeds page_view

Tests: server (PGlite): accepted types only, caps and clamps, foreign session ignored, 413 over 64 kB, 429 on the 121st request, identity from the token only; app: the queue/flush model with fake timers (flush interval, pagehide flush uses keepalive, token cache refresh)
npm test and the investors checks pass

userStories.title: Admin investors API: list with aggregates, detail and timeline, block, export, delete
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to find the most engaged investors and see everything about one before I call them.
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/routes/admin-investors.js under requireAdmin: GET /admin/investors?q&type&source&sort&dir&page (50 per page; q matches name, email, firm case-insensitively via ILIKE with escaped wildcards; sort in name|firm|created_at|last_seen_at|sessions|total_ms|docs_opened|downloads) → rows with name, email, firm, investorType, chequeSize, source, createdAt, lastSeenAt, sessions, totalMs (sum of page_view and section_view duration), docsOpened (distinct documents with document_open), downloads, deckProgress {documentId, maxPage, pageCount} for the alert-on-first-open document with the most opens (null if none), blocked, plus total

GET /admin/investors/:id → profile, marketing opt-in and timestamp, per-document summary (opens, furthest page, time, downloaded), and GET /admin/investors/:id/events?page (50 newest first, with document titles)

PATCH /admin/investors/:id {blocked}; DELETE /admin/investors/:id (cascade; returns 204; the Clerk account is untouched); GET /admin/investors/:id/export → JSON attachment of the profile and all events
Aggregates are computed in SQL (no loading whole tables into Node)

Tests (PGlite with fixture events): sorting by each key, search escaping of % and _, filters, deck progress, detail summary, block then the investor's own call is 403, delete cascades, export shape, non-admin 403
npm test passes

userStories.title: Alert emails on sign-up and first open
userStories.description: As an admin, I want an email when a new investor signs up or first opens the deck.
acceptanceCriteria: server/investors/alerts.js: createAlerts({db, transport, to, from, baseUrl}) implementing the hooks W1-07 and W1-11 call; sign-up email (subject 'New investor: <name> (<firm>)', body: name, email, firm, type, cheque size, source, link https://automatos.app/investors/admin/investors/<id>); first-open email (subject '<name> (<firm>) opened <title>', link to the investor); both plain text plus HTML with EVERY investor-supplied value HTML-escaped

Exactly-once: an INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING into alerts_sent decides whether to send; sending happens after the response path (setImmediate) and a failure is logged (console.error without the body) and never fails the request

The transport reuses the site's SMTP variables (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, the same defaults as server.js's contact form) through an injectable factory; recipients from INVESTOR_ALERT_EMAILS; with no recipients or no SMTP_USER the hooks are no-ops with one warning at start

Tests (PGlite + fake transport): one email per sign-up across two profile saves, one per investor per document across repeated opens, escaping of <script> in name and firm, transport failure does not change the API response
npm test passes

Specs at 1280x800 and 390x844, each saving a full-page screenshot under investors/e2e/screenshots/: teaser (signed out), profile form with a field error, home with documents, viewer on page 2, admin overview, admin investors table, admin investor detail, admin documents; plus assertions: the teaser shows the tracking notice, the profile checkbox is unticked, the viewer shows 'Page 2 of 2', a non-admin sees 'Not available' on /investors/admin
